_comment: English content names. The screens' own English lives in UiStrings and is not repeated here -- this file carries only what the code has no opinion about: what the world's items, monsters, NPCs, maps and quests are called. Deliberately NOT translated into Thai: a Thai player sees these names in English, by decision, because a name is what players call a thing to each other and two vocabularies for one slime is worse than one foreign word.

entries.text: Training slimes have been wandering too close to the harbour. Put down three of them and come back to me.
Three was a start, but the roads out of town are still crawling. Thin them out properly -- eight should make the carters happy.
The watch is short-handed and the slimes never stop coming back. Walk the patrol, clear five, and come and see me again whenever you have the time. There is always work.
The blacksmith has a cutlass on the rack and no one worth giving it to. Bring down fifteen and I will tell him you have earned it.
Something old has woken in the hills and the small ones answer to it. Do not go alone, and do not go unprepared.
The carters take the east road every morning and the slimes know it. Clear eight before they set out. Come back tomorrow -- there will be eight more.
The watch does not go past the river bend any more. You can. Fourteen of them, every day, and the road stays open.
Once a year the harbour hangs lanterns and the slimes come to see them. Twenty of them, before the lanterns come down.
